title: spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy have zero call sites — Spawn_FX.reveals is never initialized or torn down (tracker leaks in render tests)
detail: The lifecycle procs are dead code born orphaned; reveals instead rides append-to-zero-value on whatever allocator is ambient (2×192B tracker leaks in the render tests), leaving the intended ownership unwired.
recommended_fix: Either wire spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy into View setup/teardown (app boot + harness Render_Ctx), or delete both procs and document reveals as lazily-owned by the ambient allocator.

title: sfx_load_cat declares an `allocator` parameter that the body never uses — all 7 callers pass context.temp_allocator in vain
detail: The parameter misleads: callers believe they allocate from the temp arena, but the reads, parsed catalogs, and defer deletes all run on context.allocator. Harmless today (frees are consistent) but a trap.
recommended_fix: Thread `allocator` into read1 and catalogs_load (and the defers), or drop the parameter entirely and call sfx_load_cat(&cat).

title: Predictor detects the spawn via next_node_id delta — a pending Cmd_Place_Router inside the lead window plus a rejecting growth plan yields a false telegraph on the router
detail: next_node_id moves for player router placements too. With a pending place inside the lead window and a rejecting window, the ring anchors on the router's position. No current demo hits it; the app path (pending={}) is immune.
recommended_fix: Detect the spawn via the shadow's own event stream (step appends EVENT_TAG_NODE_SPAWNED to shadow.events) instead of the next_node_id delta.
